subject: Avril Lavigne
query: did avril lavigne have a baby
title: Did Avril Lavigne have a baby? Yes, the singer welcomed a girl
answer: Yes. Avril Lavigne, 42, announced on Instagram on Friday, Nov. 13, 2026, that she has welcomed her first child, a baby girl. She shared black-and-white photos of the newborn but did not give the baby's name or say who the father is.
in_the_news: The news surprised fans because Lavigne had kept her pregnancy private, and searches for her name jumped as people asked who her partner is and what the baby is called.
body:
Lavigne, the Canadian singer behind "Complicated," "Sk8er Boi" and "Girlfriend," called her daughter a "princess" in a playful caption. One photo shows Lavigne and another person holding the newborn's hand, another shows her cradling the baby in a cheetah-print onesie, and a third shows a pair of checkered Vans sneakers, a nod to the skate-punk image that made her famous in the early 2000s.

She has not named a partner. Lavigne was previously married to Sum 41's Deryck Whibley and later to Nickelback's Chad Kroeger, and she was engaged to musician Mod Sun until early 2023. Since then she has kept most of her personal life out of public view, and she did not reveal the pregnancy before the birth announcement.

The baby is Lavigne's first child. Anything beyond what she posted, including the father's identity, the date of birth and the baby's name, has not been confirmed by Lavigne or her representatives.
